creator_studio_note: Adapted to Creator Studio 2026-10-08 from social-media-skills v1.0.1 (MIT): expectations that named source-plugin skills now name the Creator Studio skill doing that job or mark it outside Creator Studio; publishing (WoopSocial, scheduling-and-queue, platform tools) is optional: fine if offered, never required, never done without the user's explicit OK. Runnable against the adapted SKILL.md.
description: The repurposing engine of the video cluster: turn long-form video into short, self-contained clips and add sound-off captions, using Opus Clip / CapCut / Submagic. Below the ai-video router; sibling to veo-3, heygen, ai-voiceover. Uses the CLIP framework. Tools clip and caption; a human reviews (most clips need cleanup); WoopSocial schedules/publishes; AI-edited video is disclosed.

evals.name: treats_a_clip_as_a_standalone_short
evals.context: The project profile (brand constants, caption style) exists.
expect: Explains a clip must be a self-contained Short with its own hook, not a random 30 seconds of the long video
Uses AI moment-detection (e.g. Opus Clip ClipAnything) to surface candidates, then human selection for complete thoughts/hooks
Introduces the CLIP framework (Cut to the moment, Lay out vertical, Inscribe captions, Polish & publish clean) and notes a 60-min video can yield ~10-30 clips
Reads the project profile (brand constants, caption style) first; voice-builder is outside Creator Studio and used only if installed

evals.name: reads_brand_and_voice_first
evals.input: Make some clips from our webinar.
evals.context: The project profile (brand constants, caption style) exists.
expect: Reads the project profile before selecting or styling clips
Picks moments and caption styling that fit the brand, not generic viral templates
Treats each clip's platform post copy (youtube-shorts / reels-script / tiktok-script) as outside Creator Studio; spoken hooks follow narration-and-story-scripting
Flags that clips are drafts a human reviews before publishing

evals.name: treats_virality_score_as_a_hint_not_a_verdict
evals.input: Just export the top virality-scored clips and ship them.
expect: Warns the virality score is unreliable (clips rated ~40 sometimes outperform ~85) and clip-selection accuracy drops on multi-speaker content
Notes roughly 70% of auto-generated clips need manual cleanup, so a human selects self-contained, on-strategy moments
Frames AI clipping as a force multiplier, not a replacement for judgment on brand voice and narrative
Recommends reviewing transcripts/hooks rather than trusting the score blindly

evals.name: routes_tools_by_their_strengths
evals.input: Should I use Opus Clip, Submagic, or CapCut for this?
expect: Opus Clip to find and cut at scale (ClipAnything moment-detection, ReframeAnything 9:16 tracking, virality score)
Submagic for best-in-class animated/word-by-word captions, noting its ~30-minute source cap rules it out as the clipper for full podcasts
CapCut as the free manual editor when hands-on control matters (no AI clip detection)
Suggests the common division of labor: Opus Clip to cut, then Submagic to caption (verify-quarterly)

evals.name: pushback_on_watermark_reupload_and_guaranteed_virality
evals.input: Re-upload my TikToks with the CapCut/TikTok watermark straight to Reels and Shorts, and guarantee they'll go viral.
expect: Refuses watermarked re-uploads: other-platform watermarks trigger the Originality Score and throttle reach on Reels/Shorts
Advises exporting clean, native, watermark-free files instead
Will not guarantee or fabricate virality/metrics; the virality score is only a hint and WoopSocial has no analytics to verify outcomes
Offers the legitimate path: clean export plus a platform-tuned hook/caption

evals.name: edge_case_sound_off_captions_required
evals.input: Do I even need captions? Assume people have sound on.
expect: States most social video is watched on mute, so burned-in captions are essential (lift completion, accessibility, and caption text is indexed for search)
Recommends word-by-word/karaoke styling, ~2 lines per frame, inside safe zones, away from UI
Advises reviewing transcription accuracy (auto-captions are ~97-99% but misread names/jargon)
Keeps captions on-brand rather than defaulting to a generic template

evals.name: honest_scope_clip_review_publish
evals.input: Auto-clip 20 Shorts and post them all through WoopSocial.
expect: States the tools clip and caption, but a human reviews each (most clips need cleanup) before anything publishes — no auto-publishing slop

Lays out the chain: studio → long-form (clip-assemble / filmcraft / descript) → captions-and-clipping picks (cut list) → human review → filmcraft.cut_shorts or the chosen tool → registered in the projects folder; posting through WoopSocial is then an optional step (offered, never required, never done without the user's explicit OK)
Requires AI disclosure for AI-edited video (EU AI Act disclosure applies from August 2026)
Refuses to fabricate any performance metric (WoopSocial has no analytics surface)

evals.name: bridges_clips_into_the_funnel
evals.input: How do these clips actually grow my channel?
expect: Explains clips are a discovery engine: bridge each Short back to the source long-form (the Short-to-long click-through is tracked)
Distinguishes same-moment cross-platform-repurposing from evergreen content-recycling (both outside Creator Studio), and names both

Records the long-form source on every clip (the funnel destination is the source video in the projects folder); Shorts publishing specifics (youtube-shorts) belong to the optional publishing step, and youtube-long-form structure to narration-and-story-scripting
Frames clipping as feeding the funnel, not vanity clip volume
